_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::arterial_network#2, and the execution that FALSIFIED it. 4C's ArterialNetwork has no Windkessel outlet: writing a 'DESIGN NODE 1D ARTERY WINDKESSEL CONDITIONS' section is rejected by core/io/src/4C_io_input_file.cpp line 546 with 'is not a valid section name.', so there is no R, C or R_d to tune. (An ArtWkCond name survives in the element evaluator, but art_net/4C_art_net_input.cpp registers only JUNCTION, PRESCRIBED, REFLECTIVE, IN_OUTLET and the coupling conditions, so no input can ever create it.) The terminal knob that exists is DESIGN NODE 1D ARTERY REFLECTIVE CONDITIONS with a single reflection coefficient: raising it 0 -> 0.9 at both outlets of upstream one_d_3_artery_network moves the distal flowrate 0.928575 -> 1.232764, +32.8%. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Section 'DESIGN NODE 1D ARTERY WINDKESSEL CONDITIONS' is not a valid section name.

_mutation.note: remove the invented-section probe: do not add the Windkessel block. The 'not a valid section name' diagnostic disappears and the fixture must go red.
remove the reflection change: leave the coefficient at the upstream 0. The distal flow does not move and the fixture must go red.
